facts.fact: SPIN says GABON FIBER S.A. takes over operation of the 1,782 km of existing National Backbone (Backbone National Gabonais) when the current Axione Gabon delegation ends in November 2026.

SPIN says it and GABON FIBER S.A. signed a 20-year partnership on 14 September 2026 under which the concessionaire finances and builds 1,651 km of extensions in three phases, taking the network to 3,433 km.
SPIN says GABON FIBER S.A. is wholesale-only and that access to the backbone's capacity and services will be on transparent, fair and non-discriminatory terms for operators and ISPs.
